chunks: "Three things ruin the body and may even kill: entering the bathhouse on a full stomach, intercourse upon fullness, and marrying elderly women."

key_terms.الْبِطْنَةِ: fullness of the stomach or overeating
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةٌ: three matters being identified and enumerated

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about practices that harm the body?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام warns against three matters described as harmful to the body and potentially life-threatening. The hadith presents practical ethical guidance related to physical well-being, bodily discipline, and marital choice.
